package.name: state_estimation_v2_cpp
package.description: v2 fork of 3DVehicleDynamicsStateEstimation's state_estimation_cpp (the 3D-EKF): same state vector, EKF, state machine, outlier-detection helper, vehicle-model and reference-orientation handlers, all REUSED unforked from the upstream package. Only state_estimation.hpp/state_estimation_impl.hpp are forked, to fix a self-reinforcing divergence bug in the hard linear-velocity outlier check: it only compared a new measurement against the EKF's OWN current fused state, so once that state drifted past the (fixed, small) outlier threshold -- observed after a processing stall under WSL2 -- every subsequent correct measurement looked like an outlier too and got rejected, leaving the filter unable to self-correct for 50+ seconds. See docs/TODO_Advisor_Action_Items.md for the investigation (three repeated replays of vegas24_pub, one reproduced the divergence; raw wheelspeed data was confirmed identical/ correct across all three, only the EKF's own v_mps_ output was wrong in the bad run).
